general.title: Order & customer sync
general.description: Controls how orders and customers are imported from Magento.

images.title: Export performance & images
images.description: Controls export throughput and product image handling.

channelStockMappings.title: Channel → stock source mapping
channelStockMappings.description: Maps Open Mercato sales channels to Magento MSI stock sources for inventory sync.

channelStoreMappings.title: Channel → store view mapping
channelStoreMappings.description: Maps Open Mercato sales channels to Magento store views and currencies for price/catalog sync.

attributeCodeOverrides.title: Attribute provisioning
attributeCodeOverrides.description: Controls how Open Mercato custom fields are provisioned as Magento attributes, including the naming prefix and per-field code overrides.

customerStrategy.label: Customer matching strategy
customerStrategy.description: How imported orders are linked to Open Mercato customers.

attributeSetPrefix.label: Attribute set / code prefix
attributeSetPrefix.description: Prefix applied to generated Magento attribute sets and codes. Leave empty to use native attribute names (risk of collisions).

defaultOrderChannelId.label: Default sales channel for imported orders
defaultOrderChannelId.description: Sales channel assigned to orders imported from Magento.

orderImportStatuses.label: Magento order statuses to import
orderImportStatuses.description: Only orders with these Magento statuses are imported. Leave empty to import all statuses.

imageSyncEnabled.label: Sync product images
imageSyncEnabled.description: Upload Open Mercato product images to Magento during product export.

productExportConcurrency.label: Product export concurrency
productExportConcurrency.description: Number of products exported in parallel (1-10).

imageUploadConcurrency.label: Image upload concurrency
imageUploadConcurrency.description: Number of images uploaded in parallel (1-10).

imageMaxDimension.label: Max image dimension (px)
imageMaxDimension.description: Images larger than this are resized before upload (0 disables resizing).

channelStockMappings.empty: No channel → stock source mappings configured yet.

channelStoreMappings.empty: No channel → store view mappings configured yet.

attributeCodeOverrides.empty: No attribute code overrides configured yet.
